description: What a cycle is: .factory/cycles/<cycle>/cycle.json (record cycle). Tracked; written only by code. Kept permanently. Cap 2,000 bytes. A later version may add a field: read records that carry an unknown field, never refuse them (decision D33).

id.description: The cycle's name: a slug of 2 to 40 lower-case characters.

route.description: standard from the opening when a brief opens the cycle; written by vsdd feature route when a change request opened it; empty for a maintenance cycle.

opened.description: ISO 8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending Z.

baseline.description: A release tag, an ingest or an import; empty for a first release. What delta runs compare against, not the commit story branches are cut from.

request.description: brief, or the id of the one request file, CR-<NNN>.

closed.description: Once closed: the close date the release checkpoint adds.

archive_commit.description: Once closed: the commit of the state branch just before pruning.
